Folks — forwarding Aurora's ask. Quick summary and recommendation below.

Summary: Aurora Labs wants a one-time credit to cover POC spend (~$22k) + a temporary bundled/introductory discount for embeddings + chat for Q1. They plan to convert to a committed plan (12–24m) on success. HubSpot HS-84219.

Proposed internal (what I'm asking you to sign off on):
- One-time starter credit: $25,000 applied to the first invoice (to account for potential overage).
- Introductory bundle: 35% off standard hosted per-token rates for embeddings + chat for 90 days from activation.
- Contract language: credits amortized over first invoice; committed conversion triggers re-evaluation of rates.

Rationale: Aurora's product team fits our high-touch POC profile, likely to convert to committed usage (they gave rough numbers ~4–6x production tokens after POC). This is strategic for our search/embeddings footprint in retail analytics accounts.

Attachments I'm sending: Aurora_MA_PriceModel.xlsx (my forward of their scoping + quick ROI calc).

Please reply with approval or suggested edits. If we need CFO signoff, Laura/Lauren asked we loop Marissa.

Thanks,
